The next person to be served is **the dark‑haired man in the pale blue / lavender long‑sleeved dress shirt and dark trousers who is standing with his back to the camera, pressed right up against the front of the ice‑cream cart** in the lower‑left of the frame, directly beneath the blue Ben & Jerry's parasol. He is at the head of the waiting line, he is the only waiting customer actually touching the counter, he is leaning in and looking down into the open freezer well (i.e. already choosing his flavour), and he is empty‑handed. As soon as the customer ahead of him takes his ice cream and steps away, this man is served.

## What is happening in the picture

The photo shows a crowded outdoor reception or corporate party — red/white/blue balloon arch, palm trees, a blue carpeted walkway, guests in business and cocktail dress, red plastic drink cups everywhere. At the far left, under a branded blue Ben & Jerry's umbrella, stands a small white ice‑cream cart. Zooming in on its top I can see an open freezer lid, a stack of white paper cups, a stainless‑steel dipper well, a napkin/cone, and a red drink cup someone has parked on it.

**The transaction in progress:** a clear plastic tub of ice cream with a green/teal spoon standing upright in it is being passed across the top of the cart. One hand grips the tub from the left; that arm runs off the left edge of the picture and belongs to the server, who is working the left‑hand end of the cart just outside the frame. A second, bare forearm reaches in from the right to take it. That receiving arm belongs to **the older, balding man in glasses in the white / very pale short‑ or rolled‑sleeved shirt**, who is bent forward over the cart at the serving point with a red plastic drink cup already in his other hand. He is the customer being served *right now*, and he will move off to the left as soon as he has the tub.

## Why the man in the pale blue shirt is next

1. **He is first in the line.** The cart is worked from its left‑hand end and the queue feeds in from the right. Reading along the cart from right to left gives: queue → man in pale blue shirt → bespectacled man in white (being served now) → server off‑frame. He is therefore the closest waiting customer to the serving point.
2. **He is already at the counter.** His body is squared up and touching the cart rather than standing back in the crowd, and nobody is between him and it.
3. **His posture and gaze.** His head is tilted down and to the left, aimed straight into the open freezer well where the flavour tubs sit. That is the "deciding what to order" stance of the person next up, not of someone who has finished.
4. **He is empty‑handed.** Almost everyone around him is carrying a red cup or food; he is carrying nothing, so he has not been served yet.
5. **The people behind him form a queue behind him.** A tight row of guests stands to his right, all turned in profile facing left toward the cart — a line, not a standing conversation group. He is at its head.

## The order of the queue behind him

- **Second in line:** the young woman in the black sleeveless dress with shoulder‑length wavy auburn‑brown hair, standing immediately behind him, in profile facing the cart.
- **Third:** the man in the pink/salmon button‑down shirt with the sleeves pushed up and dark trousers, also in profile facing the cart.
- **Fourth:** the man in the light blue shirt with dark aviator sunglasses and open collar, with the woman in sunglasses and the green top just behind him.
- Beyond that the line dissolves into the general crowd standing on the blue walkway — e.g. the man in the white shirt holding a red cup and the man in the dark navy shirt, who read more as mingling guests than as queuers.

## Confidence and the alternative reading

I am confident the answer is "the man at the head of the line, in the pale blue/lavender dress shirt with his back to us." The one real ambiguity is whether he is *next* or is in fact the person being served at this instant, because he and the bespectacled man are standing close together at the cart and the image is low‑resolution there. I read the bare, unsleeved forearm taking the ice‑cream tub as belonging to the bespectacled man in white — the pale‑blue‑shirt man's sleeves are long and cuffed at the wrist, while the receiving arm is bare well above the wrist — which puts the pale‑blue‑shirt man one place back in the queue.

**If instead the man in the pale blue shirt is the one currently being served, then the next person served would be the young woman in the black sleeveless dress with the wavy auburn hair standing immediately behind him.** Either way the structural answer is the same: the next customer is whoever stands at the front of that left‑facing line pressed against the Ben & Jerry's cart, and the two candidates, in order, are the man in the pale blue dress shirt and then the woman in the black dress.
